Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 1) demonstrates extensive, unilateral confluent consolidation and patchy airspace opacities in the left lung, which is a classic radiographic presentation of invasive pulmonary aspergillosis in an immunocompromised patient (renal transplant recipient). This pattern distinguishes it from the focal cavitary lesion of an aspergilloma or the fleeting opacities of ABPA.
